g.text: Diagnostic recovery by changing the initial tube configuration
Same proposed tubes, hardware limits, 20 steps and 40-iteration budget; alternative trajectories checked at 2,001 positions.
Post-hoc investigation of two selected failures—not an independently evaluated initialization method or an amended completion score.
